title: Where the XRP from the Binance breach went
seo_title: Binance Breach XRP Timeline: Where 233.5M XRP Went | Case Files
description: Day by day: where the 233.5 million XRP taken in the Oct 29, 2026 Binance breach went, and how about 216 million reached exchange deposits by Nov 12.
short: On October 29, 2026, about 233.5 million XRP left five Binance wallets for one new wallet. Over the next 14 days it was split, collected again, broken into small amounts and passed through a chain of wallets. By November 12 about 216 million XRP, roughly 93% of it, had been paid into deposit accounts at about ten exchanges and swap services.

timeline.title: Six hub wallets are created
timeline.text: Six new wallets are opened within 20 seconds of each other. Each takes over the balance of an older wallet that had been doing the same job since at least April. These six later carry most of the money.

timeline.title: 233.5 million XRP leaves Binance
timeline.text: Five Binance wallets pay 233,461,943 XRP to one new wallet in about four minutes.

timeline.title: Three days of nothing
timeline.text: The wallet sits untouched for three days and seven hours.

timeline.title: Split six ways
timeline.text: In eight minutes the wallet sends everything to six new wallets: five get 40 million XRP each and one gets 33.45 million.

timeline.title: The pay-out starts
timeline.text: One of the six, which we call the collection wallet, starts paying out in chunks of about 140,000 XRP, roughly one a minute, day and night.

timeline.title: The other five empty into it
timeline.text: One by one, the other five wallets send their whole balance to the collection wallet: Nov 6 at 1:06 AM and 9:50 PM, Nov 8 at 6:53 PM, Nov 9 at 12:18 PM and Nov 10 at 7:01 PM.

timeline.title: Through the hubs and out to exchanges
timeline.text: The chunks go to short-lived wallets, then into the six hub wallets, then to pay-out wallets that each pay one exchange deposit account, 100 to 150 times a day.

timeline.title: The collection wallet is empty
timeline.text: Its last payment goes out. It is left holding 4.54 XRP. The other five split wallets are down to 5 to 11 XRP each.

timeline.title: About 216 million XRP has reached exchanges
timeline.text: By this time about 216 million XRP had been paid into exchange deposit accounts through the hub wallets. About 1.1 million XRP is still sitting in the hubs.

legs.name: Binance to the first wallet
legs.note: Five payments, 4:05 to 4:09 PM on Oct 29.

legs.name: Waiting in the first wallet
legs.note: Not a single payment out until Nov 1.

legs.name: Split into six wallets
legs.note: Each wallet held its share untouched until it was called on, the last on Nov 10.

legs.name: The collection wallet pays out
legs.note: 1,289 payments, about one a minute, from Nov 5 to Nov 12.

legs.name: Pay-out wallets to exchanges
legs.note: Each pays one exchange deposit account, 100 to 150 times a day.

exchanges.name: Others and unlabelled

unknowns: Who controls the six hub wallets. They were set up before October 29 and handled smaller amounts for months before it, so they could belong to the same people as the first wallet or to a swap or trading service those people used.

How much of the hub money was from the breach. About 85% of what the hubs took in from Nov 5 can be followed back to the first wallet. The rest came from other wallets, so 216 million is the most that could be breach money, not an exact count.
What happened after the deposits. Once XRP is inside an exchange it moves on the exchange's own books, which are not public.
